characterizations.result_summary: FTIR spectra detected characteristic functional groups of polyamides I-IV, confirming their proposed chemical structures.

evidence.source_sentence: The FT-IR spectra of the polymers in KBr pellets (2%) were recorded using a Nicolet FT-IR (510P) spectrophotometer.
The chemical structures of the prepared polyamides were confirmed by FT-IR and elemental analysis. The results are shown in Table 1.

The FT-IR spectra of polymers (Table 1) show that all the spectra have the stretching vibration for the C=O group $( 1 , 6 5 3 { - } 1 , 6 5 7 \ \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 } )$and the N–H group $( 3 , 3 9 4 - 3 , 3 9 8 ~ \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 } )$in the acylamide linkage, the stretching vibration for CN group $( 2 , 2 3 1 - 2 , 2 3 3 ~ \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 } )$, the stretching vibration for $\mathrm { C - N } ( 1 , 2 4 4 - 1 , 2 4 7 ~ \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 } )$, and the stretching vibration for the ether group asymmetrical vibration of Ar–O–Ar (1,241– $1 { , } 2 4 2 \ \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 } )$, indicating that the prepared polyamides have the proposed structures.
